preconditions.description: The number of students is between 1 and 1000, inclusive.
Each student's report is a valid student number.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n integers.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= output[i] <= n for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: Each output integer is a valid student number.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] == find_second_hole(i + 1, p) for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: For each student a, the output is the student who would receive two holes in the badge if a was the first student caught by the teacher.
